newsitem.title: USA: BankBoston opens emerging mkt derivatives.
newsitem.headline: BankBoston opens emerging mkt derivatives.

text.p: BankBoston said it formed an emerging markets derivatives unit by hiring three professionals from ING Barings in New York.
The unit will focus on structuring emerging market derivatives such as structured notes, repackaged assets, swaps, trusts and credit derivatives, the bank said.
Emerging market derivatives collapsed after the Mexican peso crisis, but have revived this year and are now one of the fastest growing derivatives sectors, market participants said.
Kevin Murphy, formerly head of the structured asset group at ING Baring Securities, joined as director and head of the emerging market derivatives group.
James Santaniello, formerly global head of emerging market debt options trading at ING, joined as director and head of emerging markets derivatives trading.
Antonio Ferreira, formerly director of treasury and derivatives support fro ING Capital Holdings, joined as director and head of global derivatives operations.
